tob-0161: In this early Jung work, the great Swiss thinker breaks with Freud and maps the unconscious as a sea of mythic images. tob-10261: Athanasius Kircher’s Great Art of Light and Shadow — 1646 — is the Jesuit polymath’s vast illustrated treatise on optics. tob-10361: Johann Wier’s Pseudomonarchia Daemonum — 1563 — catalogs the sixty-nine demons of hell, with their ranks, seals, and offices. arxiv-2606-18161: Ana Palacios and colleagues propose closest accessible symmetry reduction as a tool for Hamiltonian interpolation analysis. plos-pone-0003861: In 2008, a team modeled how killer T cells take aim. Combining experiments with computation, they studied how microtubule stabilization shapes T-cell polarity during attack. The work reveals the cytoskeletal choreography behind the immune system's precision strikes.

plos-pone-0358561: PROTACs are a new class of drugs that mark disease proteins for destruction by the cell’s own garbage disposal. plos-pone-0358761: Measuring knee joint space with ultrasound during a valgus stress test could track arthritis — if the measurement is reliable. plos-pone-0356761: Female genital mutilation/cutting leaves lasting harm, including to sexual health. plos-pone-0357961: Smart insoles can read your day from your feet. This study classified daily activities using WalkinSense, a wireless instrumented insole, in a semi free-living setting. plos-pone-0358261: Severe underbites complicate orthodontics — the thin bone housing the lower front teeth sets the limit. plos-pone-0357661: Census data could flag the neighborhoods where teen depression concentrates. plos-pone-0355961: Concrete that heals its own cracks and carries recycled waste could transform construction. plos-pone-0356461: Women with polycystic ovary syndrome show elevated levels of CTRP-1, a fat-derived signaling protein. This case–control study established that circulating CTRP-1 runs high in PCOS. The finding adds a new piece to the metabolic puzzle of a condition affecting millions of women.
plos-pone-0356261: As forests regrow, the soil’s carbon-nitrogen-phosphorus balance shifts in predictable succession. The stoichiometric story reveals how recovering forests rebuild their underground economy.
plos-pone-0355561: India’s second National Mental Health Survey will shape policy for a billion-plus people — so its quality control must be airtight. This paper laid out the survey’s quality control protocol. The rigorous protocol aims to produce mental health data the nation can genuinely trust.
plos-pone-0353661: Smooth-coated otters are vanishing from the Ganga River Basin — but where should conservation focus? This paper went beyond sightings, using ensemble modeling to identify conservation hotspots for Lutrogale perspicillata. plos-pone-0356061: Crop pests destroy harvests — and AI can identify them in the field. plos-pone-0353861: Young adults with familial heart disease in highly consanguineous populations carry genetic clues. The findings bring precision cardiology to communities where cousin marriage concentrates rare variants.
plos-pone-0355461: Oral exams in medical education are high-stakes and often haphazard. This systematic review examined structured approaches to improving their outcomes, building an evidence-based framework. plos-pone-0348861: Protein families hide motif–domain patterns that alignment-aware tools can reveal. The software gives protein scientists a sharper lens on the sequence features that define function.
plos-pone-0354961: Young-onset diffuse gastric cancer — striking the young with a particularly vicious form — needs molecular mapping. plos-pone-0355161: Clustering images without sharing data — federated DBSCAN — protects privacy while finding patterns. This paper developed federated parameter-free DBSCAN and applied it to image recognition. The privacy-preserving clustering brings collaborative AI to sensitive visual data.
plos-pone-0353261: Smartwatches estimate calorie burn — but body fat and skin tone may skew the numbers. This paper tested their accuracy across those variables. The findings expose the biases hiding in wearables’ algorithms — with implications for everyone trusting their watch’s calorie counts.
plos-pone-0353761: Identifying microbes from blood agar plates — by AI reading two inputs. This paper built a dual-input deep learning system for that identification. The automated microbiology promises faster diagnoses — when hours decide whether infections are caught in time.
plos-pone-0354661: African and African-Caribbean people with dementia — in the UK — face delayed support with compounding harms. This paper identified their support needs and the impacts of delay. The findings demand dementia services that reach Black families earlier — with cultural competence, not just good intentions.
plos-pone-0332561: Hohoe, Ghana — SARS-CoV-2 infection factors in a case-control study. This paper identified them. The findings reveal what drove COVID-19 in a Ghanaian municipality — local evidence for local public health.
plos-pone-0354361: Counting the dead — death registration completeness in Ghana — underpins all mortality statistics. This paper evaluated completeness using multiple data sources and methods. plos-pone-0354461: Respiratory infections cost adults directly — in medical bills that health systems must understand. plos-pone-0353361: Fragmented care — its association with financial and clinical outcomes after TAVR heart valve replacement. This U.S. retrospective cohort examined it. plos-pone-0353161: Hydrothermal fluorite deposits — their material sources and magmatic-tectonic controls. This paper mapped them. plos-pone-0354261: Dhaka medical students’ mental stress — its academic and psychological determinants. This multinomial logistic regression study identified them. plos-pone-0353561: Quality of dying and death — questionnaire’s content validity in North American hospices. This paper established it for the revised global version. plos-pone-0354161: Middle-aged men with severe sleep apnea — uric acid and red cell distribution width associated. This paper demonstrated it. The routine blood markers flagged the worst apnea. The findings offered simple screening — from the complete blood count to the sleep lab.
plos-pone-0329161: Isotretinoin adverse events — 20 years of FAERS and EudraVigilance data mined. This pharmacovigilance study did so. The signal mining revealed the acne drug’s real-world harms. The findings balanced clear skin against the risks — two decades of reports, distilled.
plos-pone-0352261: Construction sites — sprawling, dynamic, hazardous — need eyes in the sky. This paper introduced the Helikite aerial sensing system for monitoring them. plos-pone-0352161: Mpox diagnosis — AI-driven via deep learning models. This paper built them. The models recognized the lesions from images. plos-pone-0353061: Chinese novice dentists — their perspectives on ergonomic loupes in clinical practice, qualitatively analyzed. This paper did so. plos-pone-0352461: Avicennia marina in Iran — morphology and phylogeny. This paper studied the mangrove. The findings placed the Iranian populations. plos-pone-0351061: Chinese manufacturing exports — artificial intelligence’s impact on their technological complexity, via mediating effects analysis. This paper researched it. plos-pone-0331161: Citizen science — ten recommendations for strengthening it, co-produced from challenges and opportunities. This paper offered them. The analysis paired researchers with volunteers. plos-pone-0352861: Finerenone in Saudi diabetic kidney disease — real-world outcomes. This paper reported them. The analysis tracked the drug beyond the trials. Its value is the clinic’s reality. plos-pone-0352661: Health Literacy Instrument for Adults with Tuberculosis — culturally adapted and psychometrically validated in India. This paper did so. The tool now speaks India’s TB context. Its public health value is measurement. The work gives the TB program its literacy gauge.
plos-pone-0351161: E. coli persistence — membrane composition as the key factor, from an integrative multi-omics approach. This paper pointed to it. The analysis wove the omics into the membrane story. Its microbiology value is the mechanism. The work finds the persister’s armor in its lipids.
plos-pone-0352761: UK Achilles tendon ruptures — non-surgical management experiences, qualitatively studied. This paper gathered them. The narratives traced recovery without the knife. plos-pone-0351661: Multidrug-resistant E. coli from rohu fish gills — genomic characterization of resistome, virulence, and pathogenicity. This paper did so. The analysis sequenced the aquaculture threat. Its One Health value is the insight. The work finds the superbug in the fish’s gills.
plos-pone-0351561: K64 hypervirulent carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae — phenotypic and molecular characterization. This paper did so. The analysis profiled the nightmare strain. plos-pone-0348061: Extremely preterm infants — erythropoietin, transfusions, and retinopathy of prematurity plus brain injury outcomes, post hoc analysis. This paper did so. plos-pone-0351761: Ontario acute cancer care — a physiotherapist navigator role evaluated in a pilot randomized protocol. This paper outlines it. The planned trial will test the guide. The finding will be the navigation’s worth. The protocol prepares to trial the physio who navigates.
europmc-pmc2799461: The C8 Health Project studied people exposed to an industrial chemical known as C8, and this 2009 paper describes how the study was built. europmc-pmc2815961: Whooping cough was coming back despite vaccination, and this 2009 paper found a possible reason. europmc-pmc2851561: Germs race through tight-knit crowds, and this 2010 paper models the chase. The authors study how disease moves, and can be curbed, in networks with community shape. europmc-pmc2861661: Carnitine ferries fuel into cell power plants, and shortfalls hurt. This 2010 review surveys carnitine's role in disease, from heart to nerves to aging. europmc-pmc2876761: MRSA's toll in America was worse than thought. europmc-pmc2984261: RNA folds need predicting software. This 2010 paper brings RNAstructure, a tool for predicting and studying RNA folds. The authors' program became an RNA lab staple. europmc-pmc3131561: Seafood compounds may fight chronic disease. This 2011 paper reviews marine bioactives as functional food ingredients. The authors survey the evidence. europmc-pmc3313861: Biodiesel waste got new uses. This 2012 paper surveys profitable uses for crude glycerol waste. The authors map the options. Their overview guides industry. Animal feed led the uses. Yang's review is widely cited. It shaped biofuel economics. Plants adopted the routes.
europmc-pmc3326161: Nano-drugs got a reality check. This 2012 paper reviews hurdles facing nanoparticle medicines. The author maps the challenges. Their overview guides pharma. Delivery topped the problems. Desai's review is widely cited. It shaped nanomedicine strategy. The review is a classic.
europmc-pmc3348161: Worm reinfection got pooled. This 2012 review pools how fast worms return after deworming drugs. The authors reveal the rates. Their work guides deworming. Reinfection struck within months. Jia's team led the work. The review is widely cited. It shaped deworming schedules.
europmc-pmc3375761: US food poisoning got a pathogen count. This 2011 paper estimates the toll of major foodborne pathogens. The authors reveal the numbers. Their work guides food safety. Scallan's team led the work. The paper is widely cited. It shaped FDA policy.
europmc-pmc3420961: Alzheimer's hubs got a wear-and-tear theory. This 2012 paper shows busy brain hubs degenerate first in Alzheimer's. The authors reveal the theory. Their work guides research. de Haan's team led the work. The paper is widely cited. It is a classic.
europmc-pmc6543461: Monocytes and macrophages - the immune system's cleanup crew - do far more than eat germs: they start, steer, and resolve inflammation. europmc-pmc6547561: Big DNA rearrangements - deletions, duplications, inversions - cause many diseases, but the software that finds them varies wildly in accuracy. europmc-pmc6565761: When lungs fail suddenly - acute respiratory distress syndrome - intensive-care teams need clear rules fast. europmc-pmc6602461: A list of interesting genes is just the start - the question is what they do together. g:Profiler answers it: paste in gene identifiers and get back the biological processes, pathways, and functions enriched in the list. europmc-pmc6650661: Thematic analysis - finding patterns in interview data - is a workhorse of qualitative research, but doing it well takes method. europmc-pmc6719561: One gene can spawn many protein variants - proteoforms - each with its own mass and job. europmc-pmc6754461: After a heart attack, the heart scars instead of healing - but a circular RNA may change that. europmc-pmc6769561: Aging stokes a low-grade inflammatory fire - 'inflammaging' - and oxidative stress fans the flames. This review connects the two to the diseases of old age, from molecular mechanisms to emerging treatments. Cooling both fires, the authors argue, could extend healthy years.
